title: Hands-on with Claude Fable 5: impressive results with complex projects, including a data analysis tool built in just 9.5 hours and an interactive isochrone map (Ethan Mollick/One Useful Thing)
summary: Ethan Mollick / One Useful Thing: Hands-on with Claude Fable 5: impressive results with complex projects, including a data analysis tool built in just 9.5 hours and an interactive isochrone map — Claude Fable represents another big jump in AI — I had early access to the first Mythos-class AI model being released to the public, Claude 5 Fable.
